inheritedReferenceScript.name: garden_reference_v03.py
inheritedReferenceScript.role: Reuse the v0.3 integer physics kernel with explicit source injection and field-composition changes; not an independent second implementation.

referenceMethod: Python integer reference arithmetic over the complete 16x16 grid; not Unity execution. Profiles, map and chosen weather values were not adjusted to improve sampled outcomes.

reproduction.startingState: Every single/stress/seed case starts from the same map; no state passes between cases. Stress holds drizzle as an explicit development fixture and does not use normal weather transitions.
reproduction.profileComposition: The base v0.2 profile plus the referenced weather extension; old profile and map files are unchanged.

numericStateEncoding.rows: 256 rows in cellId order, followed by one [tickIndex,roundCount] row.
numericStateEncoding.encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON integer/null arrays; no whitespace or trailing newline.
numericStateEncoding.notWorldSnapshotStateHash: Plant IDs, origin metadata and cumulative ledgers are excluded; this diagnostic hash is not JCS(WorldSnapshot), a journal hash, or a content hash.

reproduction.hashExclusions: The diagnostic numeric hash excludes weather context, weather source metadata, IDs and cumulative ledgers. It is not WorldSnapshot.stateHash.
reproduction.growthMeaning: Integer growth delta includes background weather growth outside dice targets. Initial buds start at growth1700. No growth gain does not mean no water or field change.

fixtureSampling.derivation: Concatenate SHA-256 of ASCII quiet-basin-v04|seed={seed}|round={round}|role={mapping/outcome/oracle}|block={block}; weather uses quiet-basin-v04|seed={seed}|weatherPeriod={period}|role=weather|block={block}. Seeds0..15, rounds1..24, periods0..7, blocks0..; decimal ASCII without leading zeroes or newline.
fixtureSampling.weatherConsumption: First big-endian uint32 mod256; cumulative fixed-order weights; exactly4 bytes even for initial fixed weather.
fixtureSampling.mappingOrder: Unchanged v0.3 family/recipe ordering and caps; current-weather local need supplies weights.
fixtureSampling.faceEncoding: Six zero-based recipe indices, ordered by face1..6; die/card faces are one-based.

notCovered: Unity runtime and C# checked Int64 behaviour
durable weather entropy and journal recovery
acceptanceMeaning: Arithmetic fixtures and all fixed seed outcomes only. Weather composition is checked here; visual quality and normal-play bloom timing are not guaranteed.
